menu.dish_name: Combo Incheon ( 3-4 người )

Comes With 200G Of French Fries, Chicken Salad, Or Fish Cake Rice Cake (Choose 1). Suitable For Groups Of 3-4 People. Portion Is Calculated Based On The Prepared Dish.

menu.dish_name: Hanchoo Combo (For 2 People)
menu.description: Combo Đôi gồm : 1 phần gà không xương (500gr) và 1 phần Tokbokki Chả Cá (250gr). Tặng kèm salad ức gà hoặc khoai tây chiên 150gr (chọn 1) hoặc Đồ uống tuỳ chọn hoặc cơm nắm rong biển Định lượng tính theo món sau sơ chế.

menu.dish_name: Mochi Snow Sauce Chicken Rice (Must Try)
menu.description: Ingredients: White rice, Boneless crispy fried chicken, Egg, Mayonnaise sauce, Seaweed, Pickles on the side.

menu.dish_name: Rice cake with fish cake
menu.description: Ingredients: Korean rice cake, Fish cake, Busan sweet and spicy sauce, Side pickled vegetables

menu.dish_name: Seaweed soup
menu.description: Seaweed soup - Miyeok-guk is a symbol in Korean culture. The natural taste from the sea blended with a light broth, brings a feeling of warmth and completeness when enjoyed with hot white rice.

menu.dish_name: Kimchi Tofu Soup
menu.description: Kimchi Tofu Soup with an perfect balance of spiciness, sourness, and sweetness from soft tofu, creating a warm feeling. Especially delicious when enjoyed with hot white rice.

menu.dish_name: SALAD RAU CỦ
menu.description: Vegetable Salad Includes Fresh Lettuce, Tomato, And Green Chili, Cut Into Bite-Sized Pieces. Lightly Mixed With Mayonnaise And Olive Oil For A Mild Creamy Flavor, Topped With Seaweed Flakes And Sesame Seeds For Aroma. A Refreshing, Well-Balanced Dish, Perfect As A Side To Fried Dishes.

menu.dish_name: 1 Piece of Spicy Sweet Busan Chicken
menu.description: Boneless chicken with a rich Korean-style sweet and spicy sauce, crispy fried skin, tender juicy meat inside, a smooth creamy sauce blending a delicate spicy touch - deep sweet note, evoking red chili’s aroma and distinctive spices, stimulating your taste buds right from the first bite.

menu.dish_name: French fries
menu.description: Shredded potatoes, golden fried to perfection, crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. The potato flavor shines through, not too salty, and it’s even tastier when served hot. Suitable for pairing with fried chicken or enjoying on its own as a light meal.

menu.dish_name: Seaweed Rice Ball
menu.description: Recharge With A Portion Of Traditional Samgak Rice. The Rice Is Tightly Packed By Hand, Filled With Shredded Chicken Mixed With A Layer Of Smooth Mayo Sauce, Delivering Absolute Satisfaction In Both Taste And Nutrition.\N\Ningredients: 2 Samgak Rice Balls, Shredded Chicken, Seasoned Seaweed, Mayo Sauce. (~430 Kcal)

menu.dish_name: Chicken Breast Salad with Mayonnaise Sauce
menu.description: A perfect choice with Eat Clean + clean protein from steamed chicken breast and abundant fiber from fresh vegetables. A mild creamy Mayo sauce adds to the appeal of this satisfying light meal.Throughput part: Chicken breast, lettuce, cucumber, purple onion, Mayo sauce. (~315 Kcal)
